root_cause.text: The function gem_get_ethtool_stats() used a fixed maximum queue count (MACB_MAX_QUEUES) for the memory copy size, while the actual allocated statistics buffer is sized based on the active number of queues (bp->num_queues), leading to an out-of-bounds write when fewer queues are active.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "gem_get_sset_count() correctly computes the number of stats based on the active queues, whereas gem_get_ethtool_stats() indiscriminately copies data using the maximum number of queues". The patch changes `MACB_MAX_QUEUES` to `bp->num_queues` in the memcpy size calculation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix ethtool statistics copy size to use per-device queue count instead of fixed maximum, avoiding potential buffer over-read when fewer queues are used.
intent_record.what: Changed the memcpy size argument from `(GEM_STATS_LEN + QUEUE_STATS_LEN * MACB_MAX_QUEUES)` to `(GEM_STATS_LEN + QUEUE_STATS_LEN * bp->num_queues)` in `gem_get_ethtool_stats`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the memcpy now copies a number of bytes equal to the actual number of queues in the device (bp->num_queues) instead of a compile-time constant maximum (MACB_MAX_QUEUES). This ensures the copied data matches the allocated size of bp->ethtool_stats, preventing either under-copy or buffer over-read.
